name: Pure versioned menu publication and separate offer-availability projection boundary
phase: Specification only; implementation requires separate authorization
authority: Reuse FOOD-002B validators and FOOD-001A version validation unchanged. No shared-source correction or new FOOD-001 semantics.
Publication state is an explicitly supplied domain decision, not proof that the caller is authorized to publish. A later trusted service owns publication authorization.
Publication, current availability, legal/safety/tax/payment/fulfillment readiness and actual order authorization remain independent.
Never derive publication or readiness from FOOD-001 structural completeness, reviewed findings or unresolved conditions.

identity.rules: Explicit canonical supplied string with nonempty local component, no surrounding whitespace or extra local colon; match existing food-ID rules. Reject rather than normalize, infer or generate. No new publication-ID length limit.
identity.sectionKey: Supplied canonical local key: nonempty string, no surrounding whitespace or colon; preserve case/internal text. Unique within publication. Never generated or normalized.

types.FoodMenuSection: Readonly<{ key: string; title: string; entries: readonly FoodMenuEntry[] }>
types.FoodMenuEntry: Readonly<{ presentation: Readonly<{ dishId: FoodDishId; version: number }>; selection: FoodDishPublicSelection; offers: readonly FoodMenuOfferSelection[] }>

types.FoodMenuOfferSelection: Readonly<{ offer: Readonly<{ offerId: FoodServingOfferId; version: number }>; intent: 'informational' | 'inquiry-only'; selection: FoodOfferPublicSelection }>
types.FoodOfferPublicSelection: Readonly<{ packagingDescription: boolean; storageSummary: boolean; reheatingSummary: boolean; availability: boolean }>

types.FoodDishPresentationContext: Readonly<{ presentation: FoodDishPresentation; product: FoodProductDraft; recipe: FoodRecipeDraft }>

contextContract: The presentations parameter is an explicit array of FoodDishPresentationContext wrappers, not naked branded snapshots. These wrappers provide the exact FOOD-001 product/recipe context required by unchanged FOOD-002B validation; they never enter outputs.
Validate each contextual presentation with validateFoodDishPresentation(presentation, product, recipe); this validates exact product/recipe correspondence through FOOD-001A.
The offers parameter is an explicit array of FoodServingOffer snapshots. Validate each against its exact matching contextual presentation/product/recipe through validateFoodServingOffer.

All API validation inputs are unknown at runtime, including context collections. Reject malformed wrappers, unknown fields, duplicate identity/version context keys and missing/incompatible references. Never trust branded types alone.

Unused valid contexts are allowed but must still validate and never leak. Building deterministic in-memory indexes over supplied arrays is permitted; external lookup, persistence and latest resolution are forbidden.
publicationRules: Positive safe-integer versions reuse FOOD-001A validation. Standalone historical versions allowed; initial version 1/current sequencing/durable history belong to later repositories.
Ordered sections, entries, offers and selected media preserve supplied order, never sort or deduplicate silently.
Reject duplicate section keys, duplicate dish IDs within a section and duplicate offer IDs within an entry, including selecting multiple versions of that offer ID in one entry.
A dish may appear in different sections, but every appearance in one publication must use the same exact presentation version. Reject multiple versions for one FoodDishId.
Each selected offer must reference the entry's exact dish ID/presentation version. No duplicated product/recipe references on menu selections.

A dish may have zero selected offers for informational presentation. Any explicit individual/family/catering/custom subset is valid, including family-only or catering-only, without new dish identities.
Publication has no inferred format restriction from section key/title. Compatible means exact presentation reference, not guessed meaning of editorial text.
All selection booleans are required literal booleans; no coercion/defaults. Selected optional source fields must exist or validation fails, rather than silently dropping a requested selection.
Empty section/entry collections are valid explicit content. Revisions may explicitly replace content with empty arrays.
projectionRules: Validate publication and all supplied context before returning either published or unpublished success; unpublished is distinct from invalid context.
Valid unpublished publication returns only { state: 'unpublished' }, irrespective of internally available observations. No menu content escapes.
Valid published publication returns { state: 'published', menu } constructed field-by-field using only the declared public types. Never spread whole FOOD-002B/FOOD-001 source records.

Name, dish identity/version, selected offer identity/version, exact public presentation reference, format and serving estimate are baseline candidates explicitly authorized by inclusion. Optional fields require their own selection.
Never output FOOD-001 product/recipe references, private snapshots/evidence, reviewer/issuer identities, operating metadata, administrator/runtime data or future internal fields.
No selected description means omit that field even when present on the source. Unknown serving estimates remain { state: 'unknown' }.

Selected unknown packaging/storage/reheating descriptors remain explicit { state: 'unknown' }; unselected descriptors are omitted. Selected specified descriptors preserve supplied values, without independently verifying safety or correctness.
No blank substitution, fabricated values, readiness aggregation, implicit orderability, purchase permission or checkout claims.
mediaRules: Required media selection array is an explicit ordered subset of the exact source presentation's opaque media references; empty array means none selected.
Reject duplicate selected references, malformed/oversize references, URL-like values under FOOD-002B rules and references absent from the exact source presentation.
Preserve selected order independently of attachment order. Output only { reference } objects.
Attachment does not imply public suitability. Selection does not establish ownership/rights or resolve/render/upload/store media. No second media subsystem.
availabilityRules: Immutable exact-offer observations with positive safe-integer offer version and observation revision. All six states are valid supplied observations.
No timestamp, implicit latest selection, freshness guarantee, current-state persistence or observation-revision constructor. Later authoritative adapters select current observations.
availabilities is an explicit array; at most one observation per exact offer ID/version. Multiple revisions for the same exact offer are ambiguous and rejected, never resolved to latest.
Each supplied observation must reference an exact supplied validated offer snapshot; mismatched/missing offer contexts fail closed. No observation retargeting.
Offer availability selection true permits display of its supplied exact observation, if any. If missing, output omits availability; true does not fabricate a state or require an observation.
Selection false withholds availability even if a valid observation is supplied. No availability selected/missing/withheld stays absent, never converted to available/unavailable/sold-out.
Repeated appearances of the same offer use the same supplied observation but may independently withhold its display.

Publication does not imply availability; availability does not imply publication. Published available/unavailable/informational-only and unpublished internally available combinations remain representable.
Retired observations may accompany published informational or inquiry-only content without erasing history or creating order authority.
intentAndEditorial: Intent is explicit per selected offer: informational or inquiry-only only. Dish entries with no offers remain informational content.
Catering may be visible with inquiry-only intent without checkout, payment readiness, endpoint activation or contact data.
Featured is section placement only; Seasonal may be represented by supplied section title. No additional structured editorial badges/label fields in this first version.
Reject structured Popular, Customer Favorite, Back by Demand, Limited Batch, new and equivalent social-proof/scarcity fields. Later evidence/capacity contracts must define them.
Arbitrary section titles are supplied editorial text, not verified factual claims. Structural validation does not semantically censor or verify free text.

limits.unit: UTF-16 code units; inclusive maxima; reject rather than truncate
limits.sourceFields: Reuse unchanged FOOD-002B constraints including media reference maximum 512. All supplied text must be nonempty canonical text without surrounding whitespace; no trimming or Unicode/case normalization.

apis: createFoodMenuPublicationId(local: unknown): FoodMenuPublicationId; invalid identity throws TypeError with fixed message 'Invalid food menu publication identity.'
parseFoodMenuPublicationId(input: unknown): FoodMenuPublicationId; invalid identity throws the same fixed TypeError
validateFoodMenuPublication(input: unknown, presentations: unknown, offers: unknown): FoodMenuValidationResult<FoodMenuPublication>

reviseFoodMenuPublication(previous: unknown, next: unknown, previousPresentations: unknown, previousOffers: unknown, nextPresentations: unknown, nextOffers: unknown): FoodMenuValidationResult<FoodMenuPublication>
projectFoodPublicMenu(publication: unknown, presentations: unknown, offers: unknown, availabilities: unknown): FoodPublicMenuResult
revisionRules: Validate full previous/next publication and their distinct exact contexts.
Same publicationId and exactly previous.version + 1; reject MAX_SAFE_INTEGER overflow. State may explicitly change between unpublished and published.
Full replacement only; never merge/copy omitted sections, selections, media or fields. Missing required fields fail validation.
No version generation, lookup, implicit latest, durable append/conflict policy or mutation of previous content.
validationAndImmutability: Reject unknown own properties at every declared record/variant shape, including unsupported symbol fields; reject arrays/null as records and malformed/sparse collection members.

Catch malformed input and dependency-property access failures inside result-returning APIs and return only fixed invalid-input failure. No payload excerpts, source exception messages, stack traces or runtime/private information.

Successful records/results/projections are reconstructed detached and recursively frozen, including references, arrays, formats, estimates, descriptors and observations. Frozen valid inputs remain accepted; caller objects remain unchanged.
Deterministic synchronous pure TypeScript; no timestamps, randomness, generated IDs, caches, framework state, environment acquisition or I/O.
requiredTests: Canonical/malformed publication IDs; reject coercion/normalization; safe historical versions and malformed versions.
Same-identity consecutive publication revisions, identity drift/skipped versions/overflow rejection, full replacement, explicit state changes and history unchanged.
Valid unpublished versus published result; invalid context remains failure even when unpublished; no silent dropping.
Publication does not imply availability; availability does not imply publication; all six states; retired historical informational content; missing/withheld availability absent.
Exact availability offer/version bindings; duplicate/ambiguous observations and missing contexts rejected; no latest/freshness inference.
Informational/inquiry-only intent, catering inquiry-only, family-only/catering-only and multiple format subsets; zero-offer informational dish.
One dish across different sections; duplicate dish within section/offer within entry/section key rejection; multiple presentation versions for one dish rejection.
Section/entry/offer/media order; exact presentation/offer matching; incompatible or malformed contexts rejected; unused valid contexts do not leak.
Explicit description/descriptor selection; selected absent source field rejection; unknown descriptor omission and explicitly selected unknown preservation; no blank/default values.
Media subset membership, duplicate selection, reference bounds and opaque-only rules; selected order preserved; attachment never automatically published.
Public allowlist excludes private product/recipe references/evidence/reviewer/admin/runtime metadata. No whole-source spread or future internal metadata leakage.
Unsupported structured popularity/scarcity/social proof/new fields and price/orderable/readiness/bundle fields rejected; section titles confer no authority.
All collection/text maxima inclusive and oversize rejection; missing/null/unknown properties/nonboolean selections/malformed variants/throwing getters yield fixed sanitized failure.
Deterministic detached deeply frozen records/results/projections, frozen inputs, no indirect history mutation, source isolation.
futureValidation: Strict TypeScript checks for future two files
